risk-batch-var.Description: Overnight value-at-risk runs and scratch-data cleanup

compute.Job Spec Yaml:
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  generateName: risk-batch-var-compute-
  namespace: risk-batch-prod
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: risk-batch
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: berth
    berth.contoso.io/app: risk-batch
    berth.contoso.io/env: prod
    app.kubernetes.io/component: var-compute
spec:
  backoffLimit: 0
  activeDeadlineSeconds: 10800
  ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 86400
  template:
    metadata:
      namespace: risk-batch-prod
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: risk-batch
        app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: berth
        berth.contoso.io/app: risk-batch
        berth.contoso.io/env: prod
        app.kubernetes.io/component: var-compute
        tags.datadoghq.com/env: prod
        tags.datadoghq.com/service: risk-batch-var-compute
        app.kubernetes.io/version: "0.8.7"
        tags.datadoghq.com/version: "0.8.7"
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: risk-batch
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        fsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: base
          image: contosoacr.azurecr.io/risk-batch:0.8.7@sha256:9fc1f766c5966f41c8204ee20fcd95b79391698c56d0487a13c9a1e219e1f701
          command:
            - python
            - -m
            - risk.var
            - --confidence
            - "0.99"
          env:
            - name: BERTH_APP
              value: risk-batch
            - name: BERTH_ENV
              value: prod
            - name: BERTH_VERSION
              value: "0.8.7"
            - name: OTEL_SERVICE_NAME
              value: risk-batch-var-compute
            - name: OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES
              value: deployment.environment.name=prod,service.version=0.8.7,service.namespace=risk-batch
            - name: HOST_IP
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: status.hostIP
            - name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
              value: http://$(HOST_IP):4318
            - name: HTTP_PROXY
              value: http://proxy.contoso.com:8080
            - name: HTTPS_PROXY
              value: http://proxy.contoso.com:8080
            - name: NO_PROXY
              value: localhost,127.0.0.1,.svc,.cluster.local,10.244.0.0/16,10.0.0.0/16,.apps.contoso.com,.contoso.com
            - name: http_proxy
              value: http://proxy.contoso.com:8080
            - name: https_proxy
              value: http://proxy.contoso.com:8080
            - name: no_proxy
              value: localhost,127.0.0.1,.svc,.cluster.local,10.244.0.0/16,10.0.0.0/16,.apps.contoso.com,.contoso.com
            - name: WAREHOUSE_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: risk-batch-secrets
                  key: warehouse-password
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "1"
              memory: 2Gi
            limits:
              memory: 2Gi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 10001
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
          volumeMounts:
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
      volumes:
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir:
            sizeLimit: 1Gi
      restartPolicy: Never
